description: Borrow COOK against your deposited collateral. `amount` is the debt you take on; the origination fee (see get_lending_markets) is deducted from the payout and still owed. Interest accrues per slot at the borrow APR; repay any time with `repay`. Refuses before signing when the loan-to-value limit would be exceeded or the health factor would fall under `minHealthFactor` (default 1.1; 1.0 is the liquidation line — below that your collateral can be seized at a bonus to the liquidator). Needs `deposit_collateral` first. Simulates first. Requires a signer: COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY locally, or in external-signer mode this returns `needs_signature` for the user's wallet to sign (see submit_signed_tx).

amount.description: UI amount of COOK to borrow (debt taken on, before the fee)

asset.description: asset to borrow; only needed with several

minHealthFactor.description: refuse if the health factor after would be lower (default 1.1)

name: borrow
title: Borrow COOK on Aera
